description: 7-day dry skin outlook for a US ZIP code or US latitude/longitude. Estimates how dry indoor air will get once the heat is on (outdoor dew point heated to 70°F), rates each day Low, Moderate, High or Very high, and gives a simple skin-care tip for each level. Uses the US National Weather Service forecast; US locations only. Same method as https://corium21.com/pages/dry-skin-forecast.

days.description: How many days to return, starting today.

zip.description: 5-digit US ZIP code. Use this or latitude + longitude.
